chunks: They say: 'Then this returning will be a dead loss.'
ai.seo_question: What do the disbelievers say when they are dragged forth on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the moment of irreversible regret for the disbelievers who, upon being dragged to their reckoning, realize that the opportunity for repentance has vanished. It underscores the concept of *Fasl al-Khitab* (the finality of the matter), where the window for divine mercy closes, and their previous denial becomes the definitive proof of their loss.
